title: Parlay's Pack
description: Official Fabric modpack for Parlay’s private Minecraft server with performance, voice chat, visuals, and quality-of-life upgrades.
body:
Parlay’s Pack is the official modpack for our private Minecraft Fabric server. It is built to keep everyone on the same mods, versions, configs, and performance setup so joining the server is simple.

This pack includes quality-of-life features, performance improvements, voice chat, visual upgrades, better inventory interactions, elytra upgrades, shulker box improvements, custom map/image support, and small gameplay additions that make multiplayer smoother without changing the game too much.

Main features include:

- Simple Voice Chat for in-game proximity voice
- Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and other performance mods
- Iris shader support for better visuals
- Easy Shulker Boxes and Stack Refill for inventory quality of life
- Elytra Slot, Elytra Trims, Tool Trims, and Glow Trims
- Visual Workbench, Visible Traders, Armor Statues, and Image2Map
- Extra client-side visual and animation improvements

This pack is made for friends playing on Parlay’s server and is intended to make setup easier by keeping everyone updated through one shared Modrinth pack.
